text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At my instruction, Tosen Jordan is making nail tips inspired by other runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her perceptiveness improves, but she also realizes she isn't receiving as much attention as those around her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if trying to shake off her unease, she runs with all her might. A reporter who noticed her during the Hopeful Stakes comes for an interview.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But just then, Tosen Jordan finds herself overcome by agonizing pain… Her toenail has split.
